adversarialProbes: Under the threshold, where the page still parses on its own thread: 17 shapes at 4,000 characters measured in the read-only engine on Bun, 3 runs each, best of. The worst is the shape the suite already holds ('- ' x49 then blank lines) at 432 ms; nothing I invented beats it - 100 quotes on one line then lazy lines 217 ms, a tab-indented list 49 deep 224 ms, 1,333 empty items 262 ms, a 400-row table 79 ms, a quote and a list alternating 33 deep 30-60 ms. So the 4,000-character threshold's worst case is the one the suite measures in the browser (711 ms in Firefox, 530 ms in WebKit, both under the bound on an idle pod).

At the cap, where a slow parse would miss the worker's 10 s deadline and be handed back to the page's own thread - the one way this design can still freeze a reader: 20 adversarial bodies at 29,000-32,000 characters in the read-only engine. The worst are a tab-indented list 49 deep then blank lines at 1,907 ms and a 4,000-row table at 1,993 ms; everything else is under 900 ms. Nothing comes near 10 s.
